name: Bloomberg Arts Internship (BAI)
what_you_do: Paid summer internship at an arts and culture organization in Philadelphia, with professional development, mentoring and college and career readiness sessions.
who_can_apply: Rising high school seniors in Philadelphia. The page does not state an age range or residency proof.
pay_detail: $20+ per hour for Summer 2026, plus transportation and meal support
duration: Eight weeks, up to 35 hours a week (2026: June 19 to August 14); select interns may continue in a school-year program up to 10 hours a week
deadline_text: The page posts no intern application dates. Its only application notice is for worksite hosts: Summer 2026 applications are officially closed.
how_to_apply: The program page gives no intern application steps. Contact info@philaculture.org or 215-557-7811.
notes: Pennsylvania's Department of Labor and Industry page says children need a work permit from their school district's issuing officer. The permit is not mentioned on the program page.
